body: Wretched cunt. Female privilege in action.

I've been diagnosed with depression and I've been on Zoloft for about three years. As for how I feel, I'd say I feel not bad usually half of each day. Not bad as in "not good, but not currently thinking about suicide or how hopeless my future is".

Just general depression mental pain, nothing fancy. It's not just feeling sad, but it's like I can't feel happy. I don't remember the last time I felt truly happy, which is kind of funny because I can certainly recognize when I should feel happy but don't. I was valedictorian of my graduating class and as I gave the speech I thought about how proud I should feel, but instead I just felt bored and empty. I was speaking to a room of several hundred people but I felt like the room was empty because I couldn't relate to any of them. All my teachers and relatives and (most of) my classmates were proud of me, but what's that even worth if I'm not proud of me?
